# The Solution · FinWise

> Module 2 · Acquisition & Activation. The onboarding solution and the Aha moment that makes value land.

## Aha moment

The user sees their own cash position projected forward, and changes one assumption to see what happens. For example: "At your current spend, you have 7 months of cash. Your lowest point is 14 March."

_____

## Why this activates

They get to test with some realistic but pre canned scenaerios using their data which is low friction. They gain immediate insight from their data and can share it with people who need to know, which draws them into the product Alternatively they can use some pre-canned data which demonstrates the functionality however won't give them the same degree of aha.
